messages:
Lucy: Heads-up — Concord (ISV) wants to coordinate a joint announcement for their Gateway + our LlamaIndex adapter. Need to sync on timeline, embargo, and marketplace listing flow. Who needs to be in the loop?
Maria: +1. Sales/PS want clear handoff for the demo environment and docs. We also need pricing/packaging callouts for marketplace.
Sanjay: From eng: we can cut a shim adapter and a verified sample app by next week if we get final API contract. Need SSO details for their sandbox.
Andrew: DevEx can ship a quickstart + 1-page integration guide. Can we get a sample prompt set for the evals team?
Lucy: Good — key questions: 1) embargo date 2) marketplace listing owner 3) press assets 4) demo env + SSO 5) legal sign-off on joint messaging
Eve (Legal): I need the proposed joint messaging, any customer names, and a list of technical claims (latency/cost numbers). Also confirm whether Concord will share logos and the marketplace listing text.
Maria: Concord confirmed tentative embargo 2024-09-18. They want a coordinated blog + marketplace tile + webinar. Asking us to hold public comms until then.
Sanjay: Technical ask: confirm model variants we'll reference (redwood/llama-13b-quant vs community). If we claim \"works out of the box\" we'll need a small compatibility test matrix.
Andrew: For demo: propose a hosted sandbox with auth token rotation and an onboarding script. We'll need a Canary route in Dedicated for the live demo. @deploy-bot can you create a canary tag?
deploy-bot: Canary environment created: canary/gateway-concord-2024-09. Defaults: 2x gpus, autoscale off, retention 72h.
Maria: I'll own marketplace listing copy + pricing blurb. Need marketing assets (png/svg) and a 50-100 word summary from Concord.
Lucy: Integrations-bot, can you add checklist items to the partner board?
integrations-bot: Added cards: [\"Sandbox ready & SSO test\"], [\"Quickstart guide\"], [\"Marketplace tile copy\"], [\"Legal review of messaging\"], [\"Launch webinar logistics\"]. Assignees pending.
Eve (Legal): I'll review once copy is in. Also request a screenshot of the UI and any customer quotes ahead of publication.
Sanjay: Timeline constraints — eng needs API contract by EOD Thu to hit next-week sample app. Can product own final contract doc?
Lucy: @Maria can you confirm product owners and drop the API contract into the board by 2024-08-15 EOD?
Maria: Confirmed — I'll upload contract + Concord's sample payloads. Also coordinating with Concord for SAML SSO metadata.
Andrew: I'll draft the quickstart and test instructions. Will include a small curl example and the canary route. Snippet: ```bash
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN\" \n  -d '{"adapter":"concord","input":"hi"}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Lucy: Final ask: who will own the webinar? Marketing + Sales? We should schedule a rehearsal 3 days before embargo.
Maria: Sales will host, Marketing will produce slides. I'll schedule rehearsal for 2024-09-15.
Sanjay: Noted — we'll run a smoke test on canary 2024-09-14.
Lucy: Perfect. Action items: Maria = marketplace copy + API contract upload; Andrew = quickstart + demo script; Sanjay = compatibility matrix + smoke tests; Eve = legal review; Lucy = outreach to Concord and runway coordination. Rehearsal 2024-09-15.
Maria: Thanks — I'll ping the Concord PM for assets and confirm embargo in writing. :thumbsup:
Lucy: Thanks team — will follow up with a short meeting invite for tomorrow to confirm owners.
